subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this stale maintainer prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into the current sub-agent guidance surfaces, or paused/closed because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The remaining choice is prompt-policy direction across model-facing guidance and nested sub-agent semantics, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not close or rewrite this PR unilaterally.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
options.body: Resolve the conflict and fold useful examples into current Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, or delegation-mode guidance so there is one availability- and depth-aware policy source.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, update runtime depth behavior, config schema/help, docs, and tests in the same PR.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: If current main's guidance is enough, maintainers can pause or close this protected branch without carrying the stale prompt rubric forward.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict and fold useful examples into current Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, or delegation-mode guidance so there is one availability- and depth-aware policy source.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged nested sub-agent orchestration work is the strongest current-main contract affected by the PR's nested-spawn wording.
